blocks.text: Within the framework of the concluded cooperation agreements between BSU and foreign scientific and educational institutions, various forms of academic interaction are implemented. Among them are student and teacher exchanges, language courses and scientific internships, joint research projects and other formats of international academic mobility.

Every year the number of foreign students, postgraduates and research interns studying at BSU is growing, and the number of teachers and students of our university traveling abroad for educational and research purposes is also increasing.
When preparing a new cooperation agreement with a foreign partner, please use the approved template contracts developed by the university.
